text: Proprietary model Released October 2026 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is amongst the leading models in intelligence and well priced when comparing to other models of similar price. It's also faster than average, however very verbose. The model supports text and image input, outputs text, and has a 1M tokens context window. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash scores 42 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it well above average among comparable models (median: 13). When evaluating the Intelligence Index, it generated 180M tokens, which is very verbose in comparison to the median of 99M. Pricing for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is $0.15 per 1M input tokens (competitively priced, median: $0.24) and $0.60 per 1M output tokens (moderately priced, median: $0.87). On average, it costs $0.22 per task to evaluate MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on the Intelligence Index. At 120 tokens per second, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is faster than average (116). This page shows the reasoning version of this model. A non-reasoning variant may also exist. AA-Briefcase Elo is a combined metric that aggregates analytical quality Elo, presentation Elo, and rubric pass rate, with rubric performance converted into Elo via synthetic head-to-head matches. Elo and 95% confidence interval bounds are clamped at 0. AA-Omniscience Index (higher is better) measures knowledge reliability and hallucination. It rewards correct answers, penalizes hallucinations, and has no penalty for refusing to answer.
